letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Today feels like a soft whisper of spring, and I’m grateful for the laughter we’ve woven into each day since that unforgettable 23 Feb 2025. You’re my cutie, my compass, the gentle rhythm in my heart. No matter the miles or the time zones, my love for you only grows brighter, deeper, and more playful.
poem:
In desert dunes or city rain,  
Your smile turns sunshine into grain.  
Across the seas, our hearts entwine,  
Forever yours, forever mine.
